Metadata.description: A guide to the west coast of Mauritius: restaurants, beaches, sunsets, activities and living in Tamarin, Black River, Le Morne, Flic en Flac, La Gaulette and Chamarel.

Footer.tagline: A guide to the west coast of Mauritius, from Flic en Flac to Le Morne.
